# Cobra v1.10.2 Multi-Portal Documentation & Diagnostic Suite (Unofficial Drawlib & PNI501 Showcase)

> Unofficial community documentation, API catalog, internal architecture walkthrough, and PNI501 software audit of `github.com/spf13/cobra` v1.10.2 (`https://cobra.drawlib.com/`).
> Official Cobra documentation: https://cobra.dev/

## Portals

- [Cobra User Guide (EN/JA)](https://cobra.drawlib.com/user_guide/): Practical developer guide, enterprise CLI factory patterns (`NewRootCmd`), persistent/local flags, relational flag groups, 6-tier Viper precedence, dynamic Shell Completion V2, and hermetic in-memory testing (`https://cobra.drawlib.com/user_guide/llms.txt`).
- [Cobra API Reference Catalog (EN/JA)](https://cobra.drawlib.com/api/): Searchable symbol catalog covering all 17 exported types and 176 exported symbols across `cobra` and `cobra/doc` (`https://cobra.drawlib.com/api/llms.txt`).
- [Cobra Internal Architecture Guide (EN/JA)](https://cobra.drawlib.com/architecture/): Source-level guide to Cobra v1.10.2 internals across 19 non-test Go files (`https://cobra.drawlib.com/architecture/llms.txt`).
- [PNI501 Diagnostic Report (HTML & PDF)](https://cobra.drawlib.com/pni501/): Deterministic static Go AST, package dependency DAG, hermetic container runtime, test coverage, and security audit (`https://cobra.drawlib.com/pni501/pni501.pdf`, `https://cobra.drawlib.com/pni501/llms.txt`).
